title: Our approach to advertising and expanding access to ChatGPT
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI plans to test advertising in the U.S. for ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers to expand affordable access to AI worldwide, while protecting privacy, trust, and answer quality....
body:
